name: Prism
description: Exclusive paint awarded to players who have achieved great victories in eSports. This paint is given to winners of the «Major Rankings II» tournament.
interestingFacts: The paint was first issued on April 24, 2018, to the winners of the International Championship tournament - the Penguins team.
This paint can only be obtained in a Major Ranking tournament, and the paint also comes with Spectrum B protection module.
